name: inchat
description: Voice chat desktop app — Electron + React + Cloudflare RealtimeKit

scripts.dev:electron: bun run build:electron && concurrently -k -n web,app "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:1420 && electron ."
scripts.build:electron: bun build electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --outdir dist-electron --target node --format cjs --external electron && mv dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/main.cjs && mv dist-electron/preload.js dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run build:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage
